body:
We have rolled back last week’s GPT‑4o update in ChatGPT so people are now using an earlier version with more balanced behavior. The update we removed was overly flattering or agreeable—often described as sycophantic.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/sycophancy-in-gpt-4o).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
